description: Balances Effort, Energy, and remaining distance.
Prefers Race/Push and high Effort while Energy permits.
Prefers Easy/Steady and recovery cards at low Energy.
Reserves high Effort for difficult current/upcoming terrain.
Prefers matching the nearest runner pace.
Prefers immediately useful recovery and strong Effort combinations.
Prefers the fastest sustainable pace while leading or close to lead.
Weights Energy, position, difficulty, and distance remaining dynamically.
